description: This source file defines the Twig language's 'for' token parser, which handles parsing of 'for' loop syntax in Twig templates, including the loop body, optional 'else' clause, and associated AST node construction.

classes.name: ForTokenParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing Twig 'for' loop tags and constructing the corresponding AST nodes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a 'for' tag in Twig templates, handling loop variables, sequence, body, and optional 'else' block, returning a ForNode.

methods.name: decideForFork
methods.description: Predicate method to decide whether the current token indicates the start of an 'else' or 'endfor' block.

methods.name: decideForEnd
methods.description: Predicate method to determine if the current token marks the end of a 'for' loop.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the name of the Twig tag this parser handles, which is 'for'.
